item.title: Medical negligence cases should be referred to doctors’ board for independent & competent opinion: Punjab and Haryana HC quashes complaint against practicing doctor
item.description: The Professor of Surgery who was supervising the treatment of the victim deposed in his sworn deposition that it was not a case of negligence on the part the doctor who had operated her. item.title: State Police or its specialised agency can investigate Prevention of Corruption Act offences against Central Government Employees: Supreme Court
item.description: “The Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau (VACB) is also a wing of State Police. The offences under the PC Act are also cognizable and can, therefore, be investigated by the State Police or VACB.” The post State Police or its specialised agency can investigate Prevention of Corruption Act offences against Central Government Employees: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Comprehensive Overview of the Repealing and Amending Act, 2025: Repealed Laws & Major Amendments
item.description: The Repealing and Amending Act, 2025—effective from 20 December 2025—streamlines India’s legal framework by repealing 71 obsolete Acts and amending 4 major legislations. The repealed laws span from 1886 to 2023, including several parent Acts and numerous amending Acts related to arbitration, labour laws, banking, insolvency, constitutional orders, and regulatory reforms. Key amendments have also been introduced in the General Clauses Act, Code of Civil Procedure, Succession Act, and Disaster Man

item.title: Once plaint is returned for lack of pecuniary jurisdiction, suit proceeds de novo; Earlier pleadings and evidence are non est: J&K and Ladakh HC
